(synth_sim.sh -t, doc/vtube_sdf_timing.md). iopath: one value, or [rise, fall].

masked.why: Cathode readings latched every Clk. A write or a reset line ends at any moment, so they change asynchronously; only the cycle that accepts an operation reads them (DekatronCounter, doc/vtube_sdf_timing.md §3.5).
The same triggers of the Data counter, flattened into ApLine (synt_dpc.tcl keeps only the boards, doc/tube_count_1000.md §4); data_valid is the counter's accept (its ready is only the reset lines).

Synchronizer of the panel +IP key (TC-N3, sch/logic/KEYDB_N16; for -IP dir_q itself samples the key while IpLine is halted): it samples an asynchronous key level by design, so its setup window is always open to a violation. A late sample delays the step by one Clk; key_moved_q, the step and the direction behind them see only the synchronized levels.
